Select molecule ChEMBL ID, name, maximum phase, type, and canonical SMILES for all molecules reported in document CHEMBL1150404. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1150404'. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return the columns molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
